verdict.rationale: The source is readable in a public GitHub repo (restatedev/restate), and the vendor's hosting docs label the self-hosted option "OSS". However, a community report names the license as BSL and calls the open-source label misleading because BSL restricts building on it without a commercial subscription. That is a concrete counter to the claim that the license is open. Missing for 10: first-party documentation stating the actual license terms, an OSI-approved open license, and independent confirmation that resolves the BSL dispute.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Restate provides a distributed durable version of your everyday building blocks, letting you build a wide range of use cases
